0022600215.text: The Orlando Magic (2-7, 12th in the East, on a four-game losing streak) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-8, 14th in the West, on a two-game losing streak) in the 10th game of the season for Orlando. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Desmond Bane is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Domantas Sabonis (knee soreness), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and the teams have not met yet this season. Orlando won the 2025-26 series 2-0, most recently beating Sacramento 121-117 in Orlando on March 26, 2026.
